intent: 比較對岸巨構與腳下空間包回自身，保持高強度終點
prompt: Research comparison plate of TWO equally finished high-intensity cosmic anime environment keyframes, stacked vertically; each panel 16:9, upper label A and lower label B, no explanatory diagrams or other writing. Reference supplied is the prior candidate. This compares two complete spatial relationships, not a single-factor experiment. A: closely preserve the reference's vast suspended inverted dark mountain and thick square perimeter across a star-filled abyss, foreground wet public walkway with broken rail and two anonymous figures, one bracing a foot and hips to pull/support the other. B: keep the SAME visual intensity, approximate low camera, two figures at about one fifth panel height, readable forearm contact/supporting feet/knees, cool-black high contrast low saturation, clustered star galaxies with large black corridors, one tiny non-luminous dull crimson patch. In B remove the distant inverted mountain. Replace it with ONE immense dark thick square cosmic boundary whose nearest short stretch IS the wet walkway under their feet. It travels around the open starfield beyond the frame and returns on the far side, then visibly folds inward around its own near stretch. Create a carefully staged impossible inside/outside corner: the SAME continuous inner and outer edges can be visually traced, but the returning far edge encloses its own nearest section, a spatial self-inclusion that cannot be read as an ordinary bridge loop or closed room. Make the continuity deliberate, not random broken geometry. No portal, mirror, window, nested picture, giant glass globe, spherical room or planetarium roof. Stars must exist at multiple scales above/below/inside/outside the returning boundary and remain open off-frame. Retain central sacred stillness as an immense vertical cold-black void rather than deleting grandeur. The people's grip bridges a small LOCAL break in this same footing, and the enormous route remains unrepaired. Their bodies stay grounded; no magic beam from them, no implication that the grip controls the cosmos, no worship pose. Broad dark structure, thin cold bright edge accents, unequal near/mid/far star groups rather than evenly sprayed glitter. Each panel should be a powerful cinematic illustration, not a grey technical diagram. Keep human intimacy and cosmic scale simultaneously readable. A and B must have distinct overall spatial relations while comparable finish and intensity. Do not add religious text or symbols.
limits: 完整構圖關係比較；非像素鎖定或單因子；不把AI幾何錯亂當互含成立
